CITY OF ALHAMBRA

 NOTICE OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF THE ALHAMBRA YOUTH COMMISSION

  JANUARY 11, 2022

  (NOTICE NO. N2M22-16)

  CORONAVIRUS (COVID-19) ADVISORY NOTICE
Consistent with AB 361, the Alhambra Youth Commission meeting will not be physically open to
the public, although the public may participate by video conference or teleconference.

To watch and listen to the meeting: To maximize public safety while still maintaining transparency and
public access, members of the public can participate by using Zoom Webinar as follows:
Zoom Webinar direct link:
https://us06web.zoom.us/j/85841439431?pwd=Z0xwZVJQUE04TkNmdHBhdzF3NDEwZz09

Webinar ID: 858 4143 9431, Passcode: Commission
Or by telephone by dialing 888-475-4499 (Toll Free) or 833-548-0276 (Toll Free) or 833-548-0282 (Toll
Free) or 877-853-5257 (Toll Free) or 1-253-215-8782 or 1-346-248-7799 or 1-253-215-8782 or 1-646-
558-8656 or 1-301-715-8592 or 1-312-626-6799 and entering Webinar ID: 858 4143 9431 and
Passcode: Commission. Please Note: All members of the public calling or logging into the meeting will
be muted so that the meeting can proceed.

For those wishing to speak on an agenda or non-agendized item, you have 3 options for participation:
1) Pre-register to speak: Please email Vincent Hon at vhon@cityofalhambra.org by 5:00 p.m. prior to
the meeting with the item number you wish to speak on and the phone number you will use when
calling or the name you will use when logging into the meeting. You should then call or log into the
meeting at least 10 minutes prior to its start time. Staff will unmute you and announce you when it is
your time to speak. You will have five minutes to speak, unless that time is adjusted by the Recreation
Supervisor. If you do not have access to a computer, please call 626-570-3297 to request public
comment.

2) “Raise your hand”: For those members of the public that wish to speak but did not make a request
via email as described above, such members of the public may speak by using the “Raise Hand” function
during the public comments portion, if on Zoom. Staff will unmute you and announce you when it is your
time to speak. If participating via telephone, the Mayor will ask anyone participating by telephone if they
would like to speak after asking those on Zoom. Staff will unmute telephone callers and you may state
you wish to speak.
3) Emailed comments to be read into the record: As an alternative to speaking during the meeting,
you can email your comments to the Recreation Supervisor at vhon@cityofalhambra.org by no later than
5:00 p.m. on January 11, 2022 to ensure that the Recreation Supervisor has time to print the emails prior
to the beginning of the meeting. Comments will then be read into the record by the Recreation Supervisor,
with a maximum allowance of 5 minutes per individual comment, subject to the Recreation Supervisor’s
discretion. If a comment is received after 5:00 p.m. but before the conclusion of the meeting based upon
its time stamp, the comment will still be included as a part of the record of the meeting but will not be read
into the record.
Any member of the public who needs accommodations or who needs their comments translated should
email or call the Recreation Supervisor at vhon@cityofalhambra.org or (626) 570-3297 who will use their
best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations to provide as much accessibility as possible while
also maintaining public safety.

We welcome you to the Youth Commission meeting.

If you wish to address the Commission during the meeting, please complete a speaker’s card and
give it to the secretary. The maximum time for addressing the Commission is five minutes. If
you wish to address the Commission on an item which appears on the agenda, your comments will
be heard during the Commission’s discussion of that item. If you wish to address the Commission
on a subject which does not appear on the agenda but related to recreation or community service,
you may make your presentation under agenda item VII. Please be advised that the Commission
cannot, under the State of California’s Ralph M. Brown Act, take action on any item which does
not appear on the agenda.

When making your presentation, please give your name and address for the record. Please make
your statement as brief as possible. Thank you.

II.  Flag Salute

III.  Minutes of the Last regular meeting held December 14, 2021
  Recommended Action: Approve the minutes of December 14, 2021
